experiment: Phase 7, final diagnostic - persistent (all-position) additive decoder-direction steering with matched random-direction control

config.intervention: modified_residual += strength * direction (applied to EVERY token position, not just the last)
config.rationale: Anthropic's Golden Gate Claude clamps a feature's activation persistently; last-position-only steering (tested previously) is a weaker, non-persistent intervention. This diagnostic tests the more persistent, Anthropic-like policy.
neutral_prompts: My favorite thing to do on the weekend is
Yesterday I went to the store and
The most important skill in life is
When I think about the future, I
Here is a short story about a dog:

random_direction_control.purpose: Distinguishes direction-specific behavioral change from generic large-magnitude residual perturbation

feature_3574.prompt: Here is a short story about a dog:
feature_3574.completion: A dog named "The Dog" was born in the United States in 1885. He was raised in a small ...

feature_754.prompt: Here is a short story about a dog:
feature_754.completion: A dog is a dog. It is a dog that is a dog. It is a dog that is a dog

feature_727.prompt: Here is a short story about a dog:
feature_727.completion: A dog was found dead in a house in the middle of the night. The dog was found dead in a house

random_direction.prompt: Here is a short story about a dog:
random_direction.completion: A dog is a dog. It is a dog that is a dog. It is a dog that is a dog

finding: At matched strengths, all three target features (military, books, ' Mr') produced output degeneration (repetition, generic phrasing) qualitatively indistinguishable from the matched random unit-direction control. The random direction produced the same repetitive collapse pattern ('A dog is a dog. It is a dog that is a dog...') as one of the target features at 10x strength. No target feature showed concept-specific text that the random control did not also produce.
conclusion: Within this model, SAE, layer (6), candidate set, prompt suite, and decoding policy, neither last-position nor persistent all-position additive decoder-direction steering produced behavioral effects distinguishable from generic residual perturbation. This is a controlled negative result, not a preliminary one: activation-level causal control of the encoded coordinate was confirmed, but did not translate into concept-level control of generated text.
open_hypotheses_untested: GPT-2-small's SAE may lack sufficiently clean, monosemantic feature directions at this scale to support steering, even where reading-based interpretability looks reasonable
Layer 6 may not be the right intervention point for steering specifically, distinct from being a reasonable layer for reading/interpreting features
